description: An open cardboard box sits on a green cloth, with small items in front of it including a letter “L” tile, a white case, and a yellow rubber duck. The right hand picks up the “L” tile and drops it into the box, then lifts the white case and places it inside; next the right hand moves the duck into the box while the left hand steadies the box, and both hands finish by folding the lid down to close it.
